rejections.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Theandril dark fantasy strategy pixel sprite, Cairnwing Concord, role ui.crest.
SUBJECT: ONE front-facing heraldic crest, exactly the culture's specified emblem. Crisp large negative spaces, no enclosing universal shield, no jewelry rendering. Native64x64 centered32,32 maximum60px. Few restrained flat tones; distinctive readable silhouette.
CULTURE: Tawny feathers, oxblood cord, oxidized copper, pale scree. Narrow harnesses, folded feathered forearms, ribbed narrow shields, ledge tools. Bracketed low stone halls, terraced load courts and wind-braced lift housings integrated into freestanding settlement silhouette; no giant scenery rock or inaccessible floating castle.
PEOPLE if character or rider: Tool-using feathered cairnfolk with short avian beaks, two legs and two dexterous arms with folded forearm feather fans; human port households. No spread wings, flying poses or implied flight.
HERALDRY if UI or flag: A single stepped feather with three unequal notches.
STYLE: deliberately coarse CRISP PIXEL ART with broad stepped square-pixel clusters, restrained readable detail at the stated native resolution, weathered matte materials, muted palette, soft upper-left lighting conveyed by flat value steps. Entire isolated silhouette, generous at least15percent REAL transparent empty padding on every side. Request true zero-alpha PNG background, NOT a painted checkerboard or white/black background. Do not create a smooth painting or finely noisy illustration. Respect full native silhouette extent including tools and poles. ONE subject only, NOT a sheet, variants or collage. No text, labels, UI, border, ground plane, hex, scenery, cast shadow, particle effects, magical glow, copying known franchise characters or real world logos. It must belong to a harsh inhabited fantasy world, functional and handcrafted, readable and dignified rather than toy/chibi. Buildings may have contained courtyard flooring only within their walls; ships have no surrounding sea. No terrain tiles or animation frames.
rejections.reason: Main source inspection rejected: crossed pickaxes, circular backing, multiple feathers and ornate scrolls replace the required single stepped feather with three unequal notches. Source retained unmodified; not approved or prepared for runtime.
